name: Nue Will

abilities.name: Tiger Bound
abilities.effect: A sudden crouching tiger bound forward.

abilities.name: Black-Cloud Cloak
abilities.effect: A cloak of black cloud hides the tamer for about 5 seconds.

acquire.equipPiece: One shadow snake-tail anklet coiled round one ankle (the only equipped piece); dark-cloud streaks and crouching-bound afterimages.

abilities.name: Black-Cloud Lightning
abilities.effect: A bolt of yellow lightning from the black cloud strikes up to six foes in a short line.

abilities.name: Ominous Night-Cry
abilities.effect: An ominous night-cry sickens and frightens foes in a ring (bosses resist).

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes the night-chimera in storm-violet plate: pale ape-like face with glowing yellow eyes, tanuki-grey mane, tiger-striped clawed forearms with a lightning glaive, digitigrade tiger legs, a long snake tail with a hissing head and a black storm cloud around the shoulders.

equip.weapon: A forked lightning glaive with a snake-tail cord.
equip.armor: Storm-violet tiger-striped pelt plate with a monkey-face pauldron mask and a cloud-wisp mantle.
equip.hair_eyes: Shaggy tanuki-grey mane around a pale ape face; glowing yellow eyes.
equip.aura: A black storm cloud with yellow lightning flickers.

beastNote: Nue, the Chimera of Dread (monkey face, tanuki body, tiger limbs, snake tail)
lore: A night-chimera wrapped in black cloud whose cry is an omen: those who hear it fall ill and are struck by lightning.
pitch: The Nue is the chimera yokai of Japanese myth with a monkey face, tanuki body, tiger limbs and snake tail, whose night-cry brings omen and lightning. Acquire keeps you human with one snake-tail anklet of shadow, lending a tiger bound and a black-cloud cloak. Integrate makes you a hunched night-chimera beastman in storm-violet pelt plate with an ape face, tiger claws and a hissing snake tail, a lightning-and-fear caster paid for with a strain that spikes every time the cry rings.
untrained: An untrained holder is hit by their own omen: the black cloud rolls over them, strain jumps with each cry and static shocks burn their hands. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A hunched chimera-man with a pale ape-like face and sharp eyes, tanuki-thick torso fur, tiger-striped clawed arms and digitigrade legs, a long snake tail with a hissing head, wrapped in a black cloud with yellow flickers.
spirit.look: A violet orb of churning black cloud with a flicker of yellow lightning and a faint ape-eyed face drifting in the mist.
